name: filloutliers
expr: Bl = filloutliers(x, 'linear'); Bp = filloutliers(x, 'previous'); Bn = filloutliers(x, 'next'); Bnr = filloutliers(x, 'nearest'); Bc = filloutliers(x, 'center'); Bcp = filloutliers(x, 'clip'); B0 = filloutliers(x, 0); Bm = filloutliers(x, 'linear', 'mean'); Bm1 = filloutliers(x, 'linear', 'mean', 'ThresholdFactor', 1); Bq = filloutliers(x, 'linear', 'quartiles');
comment: filloutliers — detect (median/mean/quartiles) + replace outliers with fillmethod (constant scalar, 'center', 'clip', 'previous', 'next', 'nearest', 'linear'). Per-column processing for matrices. Tie-break on 'nearest' = NEXT (matches fillmissing). Deferred: 'spline'/'pchip'/'makima' fills, 'grubbs'/'gesd'/'movmedian'/'movmean' detection, SamplePoints/MaxNumOutliers/OutlierLocations/ReplaceValues NV-pairs.
